name: abap-cleaner
description: ABAP cleaner applies 100+ cleanup rules to ABAP code at a single keystroke.

abapCleaner.debugMode.description: Enable debug logging for ABAP cleaner

languageModelTools.name: abapCleaner_formatDocument
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies ABAP cleaner's automated cleanup rules to ABAP (.abap) or CDS view DDL (.acds/.asddls) files, formatting each file in place. Provide the absolute path(s) of the file(s) to format via the 'filePaths' argument - this is the preferred way and avoids opening an editor for each file; you can pass many paths in one call to format them in a batch. If 'filePaths' is omitted, the currently active editor document is formatted instead. The cleanup always uses the user's currently configured default ABAP cleaner profile; the profile cannot be selected or changed via this tool. If a different profile is needed, the user must select it themselves in ABAP cleaner's interactive mode (command 'ABAP Cleaner: Format Interactively'), which also changes the default profile used by this tool. Use this when the user asks to clean up, format, or pretty-print ABAP or CDS source files.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Format ABAP or CDS documents with ABAP cleaner

filePaths.description: Absolute paths of the ABAP (.abap) or CDS view DDL (.acds/.asddls) files to format. If omitted, the active editor document is formatted.

languageModelTools.name: abapCleaner_formatDocumentRange
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies ABAP cleaner's automated cleanup rules to one contiguous, 1-based inclusive line range in an ABAP (.abap) or CDS view DDL (.acds/.asddls) document. Provide startLine and endLine, and optionally the absolute filePath; if filePath is omitted, the active editor document is used. ABAP cleaner may expand the requested range to complete statements, so lines outside the range may also change when they belong to those statements. The cleanup always uses the user's currently configured default ABAP cleaner profile; the profile cannot be selected or changed via this tool. If a different profile is needed, the user must select it themselves in ABAP cleaner's interactive mode (command 'ABAP Cleaner: Format Interactively'), which also changes the default profile used by this tool. Use this when the user asks to format a specific section rather than the whole document.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Format a specific line range in an ABAP or CDS document

filePath.description: Absolute path of the ABAP (.abap) or CDS view DDL (.acds/.asddls) file. If omitted, the active editor document is formatted.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension launches a native Eclipse RCP executable.
